selection_rationale: Skill bar: >=1 candidate with verifiable repro entry + resource access conditions + evidence for all known constraints. Only local-starting-kit-baseline meets it end-to-end: files/commands/tests exist locally (prior-run evidence: parity 4.77e-07, 14 TCP contract tests passed), weights local (no download), 3-class coverage, CPU-only numpy inference within 2c4g/20GB by construction. It is also repo priority #1 (reuse existing half-finished product). Recommended upgrade paths for the reproduction phase (NOT executed here): (a) replace/extend the 0_2 head with univfd (MIT, weights in repo) or aide/spai, (b) add a 0_1 head from imageforensics_osn (MIT) or trufor (nonprofit-license risk), (c) fine-tune on the competition training zips (already extracted locally). Open-source candidates alone were NOT selectable: none covers both 0_1 and 0_2, several lack licenses or weight access, and MLLM options carry unverified resource risk.
